question: What kind of recipient, tested over what duration, is alone fit to receive a previously accomplished teaching?
premises: A certain teaching is to be given.
It is to be given only to one who has been previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for one year.
inference: Only a previously accomplished person who has withstood one year of testing is a fit recipient for this teaching.
uncertainties: The nature of the test is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year.
